_note: ACA (Arcosa) daily adjusted closes 2026-08-24..2026-10-22. Yahoo purged ACA's history after the 2026-10-23 CRH cash merger (it now serves one bar), which silently dropped the Opus 5 event driven R3 book from valuation from 2026-11-23. No public source still serves the daily series, so these values were back-solved from the engine's own pre-purge output: each ACA-holding leg was re-simulated with ACA held flat (and at +1%) from the recorded leg-start capital, and ACA_t = p0 + (NAV_t - NAV_flat_t) / (dNAV/dACA), using the 2-decimal NAV series and ACA entry fills in commit f91296e. Entry-date values are the recorded fill prices. Validation: reconstructed 10-22 = 149.147 vs actual close 149.15; 09-30 = 146.10 vs digrin Sep adjusted 146.10; 08-28 = 145.22 vs digrin Aug adjusted 145.25. Expected error a few cents.
